scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npx vite build --mode preprod && node scripts/copy-zk-assets.mjs && cp -r public/keys dist/keys && cp -r public/zkir dist/zkir
scripts.build:preview: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npx vite build --mode preview && node scripts/copy-zk-assets.mjs && cp -r public/keys dist/keys && cp -r public/zkir dist/zkir
scripts.build:start: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.build:start:preview: npm run build:preview && npm run start
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
